Most species living in extreme conditions delay their reproductive cycles; Lycaons speed up this process so that their young are born before the hottest period. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Thailand – Tropical South | E01
programme.desc: A three-part documentary series dedicated to Thailand. Although this country is mainly associated with beautiful beaches, what impresses the most is the wild nature and the diversity of animals found there, which often amaze people who come there. In the first episode, documentarians take viewers on a journey to the south of Thailand. This area is perhaps best known for its exceptionally beautiful beaches located on the coastal island of Phangan and its lush nature. Great Britain. 2017. nature film

programme.title: Wild Thailand – The center of the country | E02
programme.desc: A three-part documentary series dedicated to Thailand. Although this country is mainly associated with beautiful beaches, what impresses the most is the wild nature and the diversity of animals found there, which often amaze people who come there. Life in Thailand changes very quickly. People and animals are looking for new ways to coexist peacefully. Great Britain. 2017. nature film

programme.title: Wild Thailand – Mysterious North | E03
programme.desc: A three-part documentary series dedicated to Thailand. Although this country is mainly associated with beautiful beaches, what impresses the most is the wild nature and the diversity of animals found there, which often amaze people who come there. Phu Khieo, i.e. the northern areas of Thailand, is a wild land inaccessible to humans. The landscape here is diverse. Almost two thirds of the area is covered by mountains covered with forests. There are many rare animal species here, such as the Indochinese leopard, Malayan tapir, binturong, as well as numerous species of primates. In a land isolated by the mountains, there are also archaic communities whose members form surprising alliances with nature. The highest peak in the region - Doi Inthanon, is called the roof of Thailand. It rises over two and a half thousand meters above sea level. In the north-eastern areas of Thailand, where there was previously a forest, there are now farmlands. However, for residents, the bond with nature is still extremely important. The mountains of northern Thailand constitute the largest protected area in this part of Asia. The Huai Kha Khaeng Reserve is home to extremely rare animal species, including: Burmese bantengs. Great Britain. 2017. nature film

programme.title: Unknown India – The land of changes | E01
programme.desc: The creators of the program will present the diversity of flavors and landscapes of the Indian subcontinent. They will take viewers on a journey through the great rivers, deserts and tropical forests of this region. They will show the uniqueness of India as a land where nature coexists with civilization, and some animals cannot be found elsewhere. They will visit, among others: Valley of Flowers National Park in the western Himalayas, you will see baby turtles lounging on the eastern coast, rhinos and lions in the Gir reserve. The creators will talk about seasonal climatic phenomena that pose a challenge to animals living in India. At the same time, thanks to them, various species could develop on the subcontinent. programme.desc: The eruption of the Cumbre Vieja volcano in the Spanish archipelago of the Canary Islands in 2021 and Eyjafjallajökull in Iceland in 2010 are reminders that volcanic phenomena still occur on the Old Continent. We spoke to some of the players who participated in that historic match

programme.title: d/s Seconds until disaster. Supermarket collapse
programme.desc: On June 29, 1995, at 5:52 a.m., the largest supermarket in Seoul, South Korea, containing 1,500 employees and customers, collapsed in less than 20 seconds, leaving behind thousands of tons of glass and concrete debris. Rescuers began the hard work of freeing survivors from the rubble, and forensic experts began to determine the cause of the fire, which killed more than 500 people. Was it a terrorist attack, or another gas explosion that periodically shook the city? What experts discovered shocked the authorities and forced them to reconstruct 98% of buildings throughout South Korea. The Supermarket Collapse series depicts the incredible, dramatic stories of survivors who were trapped under the rubble of thousands of tons of glass, concrete and other building materials for two weeks. One survivor shares chilling memories of her experiences when she found herself in a space barely larger than her body, living only on rainwater. The examples of desperate struggle for life presented in this series, images from the media and computer modeling allow us to present a true picture of this tragedy and show examples of survival amid general destruction and despair. Cast: Ashton Smith, Richard Vaughan, Peter Guinness. UK, 2004

programme.title: d/s Seconds until disaster. Bloody massacre at the Munich Olympics
programme.desc: The organizers of the 1972 Munich Olympics had high hopes for it, hoping to show the world a new Germany, reborn after World War II. The optimistic start of the Olympics did not in any way foreshadow its tragic ending, when at four o'clock in the afternoon Palestinian terrorists killed two Israeli athletes and took 9 more athletes hostage. The police tried to somehow cope with the situation and come to an agreement with the terrorists, but they controlled their every step and did not make any concessions. On September 6, the police launched an assault, which ended at 13:30. As a result of the assault, all the athletes, five terrorists and one German policeman were killed. The wife of one of the athletes, faced with the reluctance of the authorities to comment on such unsuccessful actions of the police, decides to tell the truth about what really happened, and an anonymous source begins to send out copies of a secret report that analyzes the actions of the German police. With the help of an expert who specializes in intelligence tactics in hostage situations and analyzed almost 3,000 documents, the puzzle began to come together into a true picture. Our gripping one-hour film, based on eyewitness accounts, expert testimony and interviews with families of the victims, answers the key questions of this tragic event: how terrorists entered the Olympic Village, why the police forces involved acted so unprofessionally, and whether it all could have been avoided. Cast: Ashton Smith, Richard Vaughan, Peter Guinness. UK, 2004

programme.title: d/s Seconds until disaster. Norwegian massacre

programme.title: d/f The deadliest volcanic eruption in American history
programme.desc: On May 18, 1980, a volcanic eruption occurred on St. Helena Island, which became the most destructive in US history. We have collected eyewitness accounts that, combined with rare photographs, allow us to reconstruct the picture of the apocalypse that took place at that time, from the first moments of a volcanic eruption to the release of a column of ash up to 12 miles high and the appearance of deadly mud flows, sliding down with a roar. USA, 2020

programme.title: d/f Canary Islands: Born of Fire
programme.desc: Experience the power of nature through exclusive 6K footage showing the changes caused by the massive eruption of the Cumbre Vieja volcano in the Canary Islands. Follow the geologists and volcanologists who battled the 84-day eruption and learn about the formation of the Canary Islands. This program offers a unique look at the natural forces that created these amazing islands and the efforts of scientists seeking to understand and control these powerful phenomena. Spain

programme.title: d/s Seconds until disaster. Volcanic eruption on Montserrat island
programme.desc: The serene peace of a real paradise on the island of Montserrat in the Caribbean Sea was disrupted in 1995, when the Soufriere Hills volcano erupted for the first time in modern history. This sudden eruption took the island's inhabitants by surprise. Over the next two years, scientists came to the island to observe the condition of the volcano. Small eruptions were repeated, and the danger zone was clearly marked on maps. On June 25, 1997, at 12:45 p.m., two years after the first eruption, a series of large tremors began to shake the volcano. Hot ash and steam rose almost 45,000 feet into the air within minutes, plunging half the island into darkness. Following this, the volcano raged for another 25 minutes. When the ashes cleared a few hours later, a picture of horrific destruction was revealed to the eyes of local residents. Many villages were buried under lava. 19 people died, and many residents survived only due to a lucky coincidence. Montserrat began to fall into disrepute, and the authorities initiated an investigation into the circumstances of the death of those who died as a result of this disaster. UK, 2004

programme.title: QUEEN'S HOUSE
programme.desc: Câu chuyện trả thù về một người phụ nữ trong top 1% bắt đầu lại từ đầu để đòi lại cuộc sống bị đánh cắp và tìm lại 'ngôi nhà' thực sự của mình. Một vở kịch đầy nhiệt huyết của những con người nỗ lực tìm lại ý nghĩa đích thực của cuộc sống.

programme.desc: Hành trình đầy sóng gió đi tìm cha của Marie dẫn đến sự ra đời của một gia đình mới lập dị, một gia đình tỏ ra mạnh mẽ hơn máu và bền bỉ hơn DNA.

programme.title: MARY RA TAY LÀ DỄ NGAY - MARY BERRY MAKES IT EASY

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình đưa các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào vòng đấm bốc của người nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu nữ đầu tiên của người Thái và mùa 3 có hai huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh cho chức vô địch. Chương trình quyền anh độc đáo này cung cấp giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận đánh thực sự với máu!

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này mang đến những lực lượng đặc biệt tốt nhất từ ​​Iron Squad để thực hiện một thử thách mới - Dodgeball. 26 người chơi sẽ tham gia một cuộc thi khốc liệt, cho đến khi một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao mạnh mẽ và sức mạnh tinh thần được hình thành. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ cạnh tranh trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên Dodgeball huyền thoại!

programme.title: BỘ ĐÔI BÁO THÙ - MONKEY TWINS
programme.desc: Sau sự mất mát bi thảm của người yêu, Neua học được những kỹ năng Khỉ Muay Thai và thề sẽ trả thù cho cái chết của cô. Người yêu của anh, chị gái của anh ấy, người thực hành kung fu của Trung Quốc, nghi ngờ Neua chịu trách nhiệm cho cái chết của chị gái mình nhưng sau đó phát hiện ra rằng cô ấy đã bị giết bởi một vòng tội phạm có tổ chức. Cùng nhau, họ tham gia lực lượng để duy trì công lý và tìm kiếm sự báo thù.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ lính nữ ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị lực lượng đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thách thức trên khắp đất liền, biển và không khí. Những người bảo vệ nữ hàng đầu tạo thành các đội bốn người để cạnh tranh với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cuối cùng trước sáu chủ nhà nổi tiếng!

programme.title: QUAN VÂN TRƯỜNG - THE LOST BLADESMAN
programme.desc: Một cuộc phiêu lưu lịch sử hoành tráng lấy bối cảnh trong thời kỳ hỗn loạn của ba vương quốc. Cao Cao cố gắng tranh thủ Guan Yu vào lực lượng của mình, nhưng Guan trung thành với anh trai tuyên thệ Liu Bei, người cũng là kẻ thù của Cao. Khi Guan cố gắng giải cứu Liu Bei, người vợ lẽ từ Cao, anh ta buộc phải chiến đấu theo cách của mình. Cuối cùng anh ta có thể thành công không?
